name: copilot-studio-gallery
title_zh: 微软官方 Copilot Studio 智能体与工作
tagline_zh: 别人踩坑试出来的智能体配方，你直接抄作业。从官方仓库里翻现成的 agent 和工作流，不用从零搓提示词。
tagline_en: Battle-tested agent recipes from the community, ready to copy. Skip the prompt-tweaking grind with official.
desc_en: Community driven gallery of agents and workflows for Copilot Studio
why_zh: 微软官方维护，质量有背书。每个条目都带可复用的工作流骨架，比零散博客更系统，比自研更省试错成本。
why_en: Microsoft-backed curation with reusable workflow skeletons. More structured than random blogs, cheaper than building from scratch.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Copilot Studio 生态，非通用 Agent 框架。需要你已有 Copilot Studio 环境。
limit_en: Copilot Studio only; requires existing environment. Mostly concept demos, not production-hardened—you must add security and compliance yourself.
